summary: KT Corporation filed its Form 6-K containing the independent auditor's review report and condensed consolidated interim financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026, prepared under Korean IFRS. This is a routine periodic financial reporting obligation of a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation transaction. No acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, or other extraordinary corporate events are disclosed. The filing merely provides unaudited interim financials and auditor conclusions. As a routine current report, it does not fall into any special-situations category.
